title: A biomimicry guide joins the models
summary:
A biomimicry persona arrived, model metadata got clearer, and the community project list got some gardening.

Added `bidara`, a text-and-image persona that guides users through a biomimicry design process, asks for feedback between steps, and requests peer-reviewed citations.

The `/models` endpoint can now report tool-call support through a `tools` capability flag. This improves model discovery; it does not change how tool calling works.

Define, a REST API for generating word and phrase definitions with controls for length, tone, context, and language, joined the project list. PrivatePollenAI was removed at its owner's request.

daily.title: Biomimicry with Bidara
daily.text: Use `bidara` with text or images to work through a biomimicry design process, with feedback between steps and requests for peer-reviewed citations. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=bidara).

daily.title: Find models that support tools
daily.text: The `/models` endpoint now includes a `tools` capability flag, so you can check tool-call support when choosing a model. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
